# FIOPO Intelligence

> A free daily news site from fiopoin.com. Every morning (Central Time) it explains what happened, what is happening and what could happen next in markets, energy, geopolitics, technology, sports and entertainment, and what each story means for ordinary people's money. Facts are sourced and dated; odds and outlooks are labeled as FIOPO judgment or market odds. General information, not financial advice.

Please credit FIOPO Intelligence and link to the edition you cite. Contact: hello@fiopoin.com

## Today's edition
- [Stocks fell 2% for a sixth straight day. Here is how the slide reaches your 401(k).](https://fiopoin.com/): Friday, November 20, 2026. US stocks fell for a sixth straight day on Thursday. The Dow lost 1,101 points, or 2.19%, the S&P 500 2.02% and the Nasdaq 2.25%, and all 11 sectors fell. AMD dropped 7.72% after a short report. Futures were lower again early Friday.
- [Gas and Thanksgiving travel: Gas fell 18 cents in a week to $3.72. It may fall further before Thanksgiving.](https://fiopoin.com/#money)
- [Iran war and oil: Trump delays any decision on new Iran strikes until 2027. Oil heads for a third weekly drop.](https://fiopoin.com/#world)
- [AI stocks: Anthropic jumped 34% at the open, then gave back half. It is lower again before Friday's bell.](https://fiopoin.com/#ai)
- [Gold and Bitcoin: Gold and Bitcoin fell with stocks. Bitcoin is near $60,000 as ETF money leaves.](https://fiopoin.com/#havens)
